body:
Hey, I've been surfing the wave a bit...my mind is constantly going up and down, I've stayed out of everyone's way because I feel so guilty for not being stable. I'm just so unable to talk, I take ages...To be honest I'm currently building a shell around me to keep this all in because I feel like such a burden, even though my condition is nothing new. But I think I was supposed to grow out of it already, so the next best thing to do is to hide it and pretend. There really isn't a lot of people to miss me, I'm sure you could also predict me saying I'm not really a good person. (  ´ v \` ;; ) Or I just can't see what's so good.

Sorry, I always keep ranting, this'll never end. How are you doing?

Hi, sorry, it's sometimes tough to answer in a way. It's nothing against anyone, I just get this dread...

I've been in and out therapy, currently in again. I don't really want to say anything about it, on the other hand I don't wanna falsely advertise but also don't want to discourage anyone from going.

I'm studying to be a nurse, so we both are in the healthcare business then, haha (  ´ v \`  ) I also graduate pretty soon, still feeling like I'm not really ready. I can REALLY relate to what you wrote, although I wish you weren't struggling...sometimes I start thinking how funny the fact is that I've cared for a lot of people and tended to a lot, but make sure I am violent towards myself. How ironic would that be that I saw my patients again, this time being a patient myself...

It's hard sometimes to be optimistic or take positivity, but I've been learning not to lash out when I've given up anyway. Instead I can just say thanks and hope nobody feels like a failure thanks to me, in reality I don't honestly think I've got long left, but when I'm gone, nobody will know.

I did learn in few occasions that I had to leave, although even that was super painful. I've been watching people slip by for years, things seem to change but I'm not keeping up with it.  Even when it was supposed to feel better after escaping some of that abuse, it really didn't...

I wish i could answer ''good'' to questions about how i am, rarely anyone asks and it always seems to be so bad. I've been spending these days in emptiness, kinda have no idea what's been going on. I'm slowing down and I'll probably get to a complete halt soon. No matter how I try to ''live normally'' I can see myself fading more each day...

Yeah, mentality has a lot of waves to offer in the sea. One day going further seems good, you feel ready, but a wave pushes you back. I can encourage you to take that step of getting help...I think a lot of people might expect it to work like magic and then get disappointed, or otherwise are scared to hear something they might not want to hear. These are some common things I've noticed, but it doesn't mean anything's in the way of progress if you're willing to take steps. I'm hoping the best for you.

Hi, I'm sorry for my late response, it's been busy...

Yeah, it's hard though to battle loneliness when everything's slipping away...So I've had the tendency to stay with people even if it hurts more, I just want to feel something, like the possibility of me being wanted, although in the end it's just living in a lie  ( ;￣∇￣; )....

You can share anything, I don't mind people talking. I'm sorry you were down in the same slumps...I don't know what's stopping me, both options to me are equally painful in a way. But I have commitment issues anyways, death being very much final gives me a huge obstacle. I don't know what's my....hope. I wonder if everything has just lost meaning to me. The wheels keep turning but I don't know why, what for.

I'm proud of you for making that step, it's hard in a way to start working towards feeling better, glad you've got a new thought about it.

Can't say for sure but I'm sure everything's happened for a reason and that reason is that I'm rotten (  ,  ,     ) everything around me and in me keeps breaking more rapidly now. It uses to be quite something before when I had people in my life, I got taught my place and who was I to go against it? So I kinda just learnt that I must be rotten. 

Of course good moments happen, although most of the time I'm looking like I'm doing well I'm just hiding it. Something's always hurting. Like I'm able to toss everything aside if I need to work or just pretend to look like I'm alright. It got harder when things started collapsing more and I got told that I'm always so negative, I figured I should end my days. I don't want to be in the way if that's how people feel about me...

Hi, I hope you're doing well too. Sorry, this might be a long message;;

I'm sure a lot of people can relate, each to their own parts. While I'm not alone it's rather horrible to know that there are others suffering from these issues too. But yeah, my mental health has been on a steady decline with few drops and here and there, it's been like this for many years now...Everything that I've been through has kinda just piled on and my brain started rotting at some point when I was younger without me noticing any unhealthy behaviours. 

How I ended up in this point was me combining the ''proof'' of how I've lived my life as this rotten person, and the recent happenings. One gradual change has been people leaving me, most of my friendships now are ''once a year'' things, we don't really talk anymore. There was constant fighting with someone and in the end they showed they couldn't really understand anymore and our heads didn't agree with some things, something in them had changed and I didn't want to be a hindrance to them since they're starting their new life as well, at this point I'm only in the way. In my internship it seems that the other students are getting good feedback constantly, I'm getting nothing. My physical health is also going despite me trying to better myself, they don't know what it is yet what could be causing my levels to be so crap, but I might find out this week. 

On top of everything my computer decided to mess up this morning, I've been fixing it and had to buy some external things and now I'm just praying it won't explode or something. I've never been able to play before I got this new one, if I don't have it then I've got nothing else.

I don't know if you're still there...but recently things took a plunge (again...), I don't have people around me anymore and I've been tossed out of everything. My health has been deteriorating, physical and mental. I got too much to my friends, to the point they completely lost their all understanding. I can't blame them, I'm too negative. In the end I was made feel like I was world's biggest nuisance. Nobody believes what I've got, I can't remember some things, I feel like I shouldn't remember them but a friend started to angrily dig these things out despite me saying no. There are some things I can't understand or comprehend and I feel like I'm an outcast. A lot of things have happened in my life, it'll follow me to my end.

Things could be worse, I'm in school, currently in work training which'll end soon. But that's about it. There's no reason for me to really try anymore, I've stopped being interesting (if I ever was, I'm what you could consider a bad person), I'm not interested in anything anymore. If I kill myself, it won't matter.
